newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada inviting satellite applications on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Canada inviting satellite applications on Thursday.

text.p: Industry Minister John Manley will invite applications for the use of Canada's satellite slots on Thursday, spokesman Bill Milliken said on Wednesday.
"The boss is doing it tomorrow," Milliken said.

Manley said last week he would invite Canadian companies to bid for the two slots after a plan by U.S.-based Telquest Ventures and Tele-Communications Inc failed to get approval from the U.S. Federal Coummunications Commission. Under the bid, the two satellites were to have been owned and operated by Telesat Canada.
Telesat is owned by Alouette Telecommunications Ltd, which is 57 percent held by BCE Inc.
Among potential bidders, Manley has mentioned Telesat and Shaw Communications Inc.
